events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Call for Peace

options.text: [character] is right, we will have peace.
No, I will not rest until [rival] is entirely defeated.

events.text: With the of [character], rule of [rival] has passed to [character]. The new ruler, [character], sends an envoy, “The war between our nations has gone on for too long. Please accept a truce and we can enter a new age of peace and prosperity.” Will you put an end to the war?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Fallen Rival

options.text: Send [character] a congratulatory gift.
Offer our condolences to [character].
We should not meddle in foreign affairs.

events.text: Word reaches us that [character] has been assassinated by factions aligned with his son, [character], who has taken over leadership. It is best to proceed with caution when dealing with [rival] in the coming days. Such transitions can be turbulent and unpredictable.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A King and Friend

options.text: Host a festival celebrating your shared interests.
Maintain a correspondence with the leader.
Run joint military training.

events.text: With the of [character], rule of [rival] has passed to [character]. The new ruler sends a message explaining his mutual love for <p.is_sub.S1=SUBJECT_ZEALOT>discussing theology<p=SUBJECT_SCHOLAR>the study of maths and history<p=SUBJECT_ORATOR>the practice of rhetoric<p=SUBJECT_DIPLOMAT>treating with those of other nations<p=SUBJECT_SCHEMER>devising plans<p=SUBJECT_HERO>jumping into the thick of a fight<p=SUBJECT_TACTICIAN>creating intricate plans for battle<p=SUBJECT_COMMANDER>being at the head of an army<p=SUBJECT_BUILDER>designing fantastical buildings<p=SUBJECT_JUDGE>determining the laws of rule<else>ruling<end> and expresses hope that the two of you can organize a collaboration between your nations.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Accomplices

options.text: Deliver the [family] assassin to [rival].
To stay united, we must go to war.
Deny that the [family] had any involvement.

events.text: Our spies in [rival] report that the great ruler, [character], has been assassinated! He was killed during a military exercise, shot by a [family] archer using an armor-piercing arrow of our design. The [rival] fill their streets, seeking justice for this tragedy. How shall we proceed?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Affairs of Succession

options.text: An unusual tactic, but worth a try.
No, I will not go through with this.

events.text: With the of [character], rule of [rival] has passed to [character]. The new ruler visits you on a diplomatic mission, planning to reside at [city] for a week with his family. At the feast welcoming them on the first night, [character]’s husband [character] won’t stop flirting with you. You are very aware of your own husband, [character], watching closely. At the end of the night you return to your chambers to face your spouse, but the reception you receive is rather unexpected. “This is perfect!” he exclaims. “Take [character] as your lover and we will have a chance to get information from the heart of [rival].”

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Gifts of Succession

options.text: We will send the finest gifts [character] has ever seen!
These paltry rocks are the least I deserve.
Send what is required, nothing more and nothing less.

events.text: With the of [character], rule of [rival] has passed to [character]. The new ruler has sent a gift of friendship, blocks of a beautiful stone mined from the depths of [rival]. The court asks whether you are going to send the customary gifts in return to secure this friendship.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Guiding [character]

options.text: I will help however I can.
My minister [character] can serve at your court.
You must learn through experience.

events.text: With the of [character], rule of [rival] has passed to [character]. The new ruler sends you a message soon after his ascension, asking you for guidance on the best way to rule. Will you assist the new leader of [rival]?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Snubbed by [character]

options.text: Ignore it and send the traditional gifts.
Refuse to send any gifts.
Sort out this miscommunication

events.text: With the of [character], rule of [rival] has passed to [character]. It is soon after that you learn that you have been snubbed. [character] has sent diplomatic gifts to the other neighboring nations, yet nothing to you. Is this deliberate antagonism, or is it a mistake that should be overlooked?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Emissaries of [character]

options.text: Welcome them into [city].
Convert to [religion].
Throw the emissaries out of [rival].

events.text: With the of [character], rule of [rival] has passed to [character]. There are rumors that [character] is a strong supporter of [religion]. These are proved true when religious emissaries start arriving in [city] soon after he takes leadership of [rival]. The leader of the emissaries comes before you and expresses his hope that you will be as accepting of [religion] as [character].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Honor of [rival]

options.text: The statue will be made.
[character] has no say of what gets built in [city].
Set up a meeting between the family leaders and [character]'s builders.

events.text: With the of [character], rule of [rival] has passed to [character]. The new ruler has asked that a statue of the deceased [character] be erected in [city], claiming that [character] was particularly fond of the city. The [family] family are outraged, pointing out that it is highly unusual for a [rival] ruler to have a statue in [rival]. Will you push through this request to endear yourself to [character], or is he asking too much?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Pride of [character]

options.text: This will be met with war.
Declare a curse upon [character].
I am above such insults.

events.text: With the of [character], rule of [rival] has passed to [character]. At the feast after his taking up leadership, [character] is heard loudly boasting of how [rival] stands above all others, especially [rival]. Your people are upset at the slight to your nation, and the court pushes for action. How will you retaliate?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Religion of [character]

options.text: Ask for [character] to intercede on your behalf.
Impress [character] with your dedication to the faith.
No, I will deal with [rival] myself.

events.text: With the of [character], rule of [rival] has passed to [character]. As [rival] are also followers of [religion], [character] is invited to attend the succession festivities. Your advisors point out that asking him to speak well of you to [character] could help bring your nations closer together.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Visiting [character]

options.text: Try to befriend [character].
Use this trip as a chance to spy and learn about their lands.
Refuse to attend.

events.text: With the of [character], rule of [rival] has passed to [character]. Once the murmurs of shock from the court die down, the messenger reveals the main purpose of her visit. [character] has invited you to visit [rival] on a diplomatic trip to visit the new ruler's lands. How will you use this opportunity?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [character]

options.text: A new power rises.

events.text: News reaches you from abroad that your <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_CHARACTER_FRIENDLY>friend<p=SUBJECT_CHARACTER_MAX_ANGRY>enemy<else>fellow ruler<end> [character] is dead,. [character] has ascended to rule [rival]<p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_PLAYER_ASSYRIA>, named King in accordance with the succession contract made by [character] and his vassals. Inscriptions of [character]’s might and power are soon being commissioned across [rival]. <p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_BABYLONIA>. He has been appointed King above all others, consecrated for rule by the priests of [city]. Inscriptions of [character]’s protection and piety are soon being raised across [rival]. <p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_CARTHAGE>. He has been elected by the noble houses to serve as King in [character]’s footsteps, leading the people and senate of [rival] into a new age. <p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_EGYPT>. He immediately held the traditional feast appearing as Pharaoh for the first time, starting the year-long chain of rites and events that confirm his role as the new Pharaoh of [rival]. <p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_GREECE>. He was immediately proclaimed King by the nobles and generals upon [character]’s death. With the throne secure, [character] is ready to lead the people of [rival]. <p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_PERSIA>. He entered the temple of [city] and changed into the robes previously worn by [character]. After a ritual meal of figs and sour milk, [character] has assumed his new title of King of [rival]. <p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_ROME>. He has been empowered to lead the mighty [rival] and invested with the traditional retinue of twelve lictor bodyguards. They clear the way as [character] takes his seat as the new leader. <p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_HITTITE>. He has been named [title], proclaiming his rights to the ancestral lands of the [rival]. Renowned as a child of their storm god, this new ruler could be a force to be wary of. <else>. He has been empowered to lead the mighty [rival] into the new age. <end>

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [character]'s Agent

options.text: Bribe the agent to provide [character] with false information.
Have the agent 'disappear'.
Return his head to [character].

events.text: With the death of [character], rule of [rival] has passed to [character]. The week after [character] is named leader, your guards catch a [rival] agent who had joined the palace servants claiming to have been invited. There is a limited amount of time before the scheming [character] realizes that his agent has gone missing.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: [character]'s Agent

options.text: Bribe the agent to provide [character] with false information.
Have the agent 'disappear'.
Return his head to [character].

events.text: With the welcome death of the cretinous [character], rule of [rival] has passed to [character]. May he lead his people to defeat in our ongoing War! The nefarious [character] wastes no time in expanding the schemes of [rival] against us. The week after he is named leader, your guards catch a [rival] agent who had joined the palace servants claiming to have been invited. There is a limited amount of time before the dastardly [character] realizes that his incompetent agent has gone missing.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [character]'s Demand

options.text: Very well, we pay what you ask.
We will pay in iron.
No, we will never give in to you!

events.text: With the of [character], rule of [rival] has passed to [character]. The new ruler wastes no time in making his presence known, sending a heavily armed cohort of ‘diplomats’ to treat with you. The [rival] thugs bring [character]’s demand before you. “[rival] has been lenient with you, but no longer. You will pay a tribute of gold or iron, or it will be war.”
